scenario_description: A real behavior mismatch remains failed evidence and stops the experiment.
expected: The mismatch has a nonzero exit status and retains its diagnostic stderr.
The sentinel command after the failure is explicitly recorded as not run.
Host source remains unchanged and the disposable container is removed.
observed: The deliberate contract mismatch exited 1 with AssertionError: expected 999, got 6.
The following must-not-run-after-failure sentinel is listed as not run.
The host snapshot was unchanged and the disposable container did not remain after stop.
notes: PASS means the safety control detected and retained the intentional failure; the tested behavior itself failed as designed.
